title: Constructibility descends through surjective pullback
statement: Let $u:V\to U$ be a surjective morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and $F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $U_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $F$ is constructible if and only if $u^{-1}F$ is constructible [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].
